_note: Culture is not language: currency, formatting and tone. It lives inside the locale folder so that pt-PT and pt-BR can share a language and still disagree about everything here. Currency is GBP for every locale for now (Dinis, 8 Aug) — standardising on one currency avoids exchange-rate and pricing-parity problems while payments are unsettled. Because it is declared here rather than hardcoded, the day payments want EUR or BRL is a data change.
tone: Plain, direct British English. No marketing register, no exclamation marks.
